name: scRNA-seq batch-effect correction benchmark
description: Compares and evaluates batch-effect correction methods for single-cell RNA-sequencing across multiple datasets and performance metrics.
evaluation_method: composite_score (combination of integration and biological conservation metrics such as ARI, silhouette score, kBET / LISI)
general_score_metric: composite_score (integration of ARI, LISI/kBET and other mixing/conservation metrics)
reputation: Well-regarded and commonly used within the single-cell bioinformatics community for systematic comparison of batch-correction methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance and rankings depend strongly on datasets and chosen metrics. Risks include over-correction (loss of biological signal), sensitivity to class imbalance and small batch sizes, and metric trade-offs between batch mixing and biological conservation.
